structs.name: LUITraceRunner
structs.size_evidence: LUITraceRunner::Initialize@0x141B14CB0 returns LUITraceRunner_InitializeQueues(&qword_1519A5AF0 + 4728 * clientIndex); the global is _QWORD-typed, so the byte stride is 4728 * 8 = 37824. LUITraceRunner_UpdateClient@0x141B14230 uses the same stride and passes that pointer to StartRequests. replay_max_access_end is also 37824. Game-test/IDA 37832 has an 8-byte tail pad (_pad93C0) that Replay never uses.

structs.notes: Pool sizes and the -8 shift are confirmed by InitializeQueues and FlushClientRequests (request item 136 bytes, 200 items, pool 27608). The residual is fully before m_physicsPredictiveResourcePool. The size 37824 is a proposal for the coordinator (it changes the total size); it is proven by the qword-typed stride. Child struct LUITraceRequest (136-byte item) was not checked; it belongs to another struct entry.
